additional_info.subject: ID0420705-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001360] TECHNICAL ERROR CRM:00798002121
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
Customer have reported error in the Charger.
For the error, Converter not found, CanCommLoss
First of all, We need to identify the converter that is missing in the following list.
We need to check if the
CAN communication wires are tight.
as per schematic provided.
We recommend having following as spare while site intervention. If Wiring is found to be faulty, we may need to consider replacing same.
For selfTestError Error Flag,
We could see the charger is on FW v6.0.3, We recommend to update it to latest FW v6.1.3.
As of now, Error Flag don't exist.
Reboot solves the issue. If it prolongs after FW update, we can investigate further.
